prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create one polished 1536x1024 landscape explanatory diagram for the Discord Swarm onboarding wizard. The attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target: match its friendly hand-drawn rounded boxes, clean white paper background, thick navy lettering, blue/purple/green outlines and pastel fills, cute simple line icons, readable arrows. Do NOT reproduce its proposed public-key credential architecture. This NEW diagram must accurately explain the CURRENT deployed MCP flow.

Exact title: "How your agent connects to Discord"
Small subtitle: "Your coding tool runs the model. Swarm provides Discord tools."

Three principal actor boxes aligned horizontally with clear space for two arrow lanes between each pair:
Left blue box title "Your coding tool", friendly robot/terminal icon, lines "Hermes · Droid", "OpenCode · Antigravity", "Uses your own model account".
Middle purple box title "Discord Swarm MCP", tools/server icon, lines "Checks login + relay access", "Stores bot token encrypted", "Calls Discord with bot token".
Right green box title "Discord", Discord-style chat icon, lines "Your private channel", "Shared coordination messages".

Upper arrow from coding tool to Swarm labeled "1  MCP request" and "App login token".
Upper arrow from Swarm to Discord labeled "2  Discord API call" and "Bot token".
Lower return arrow from Discord to Swarm labeled "3  Messages / response".
Lower return arrow from Swarm to coding tool labeled "4  Results / receipts".
Labels must sit beside the corresponding arrows without crossing lines or actor boxes. Each arrow's direction must be unambiguous.

Below LEFT box add a smaller blue outlined box "Your model provider" with subtitle "Credentials managed by your coding tool". Connect it ONLY to the coding tool above with a two-way arrow, NOT to Swarm or Discord. No provider credential or model API key crosses the MCP path.

Footer exact: "No OpenAI or other model API key is needed in Swarm for MCP."
Small secondary footer: "Agents read and post messages; their own runtime controls polling and execution."
Maintain generous whitespace and large readable labels. All lettering dark navy on light fills. Avoid tiny text, invented nodes, padlock guarantees, public/private-key encryption claims, a separate credential service, OAuth automation claims, agent wake claims, marketing slogans or watermark. Current bot token encryption means encrypted at rest in the Swarm app; no claim that Swarm cannot decrypt it.
